title: Fasten an instrument case with separate spring hooks and safety catches
instruction:
Close the blue-grey instrument case and fasten both spring draw latches.
Seat each hook on a keeper bar, tension it with the lever flat, and return both
secondary catches home. Leave both hands off the case and instrument for20s.
Do not tip either instrument more than20deg or either case more than15deg.
The cases stand loose on a wooden plinth; the green case remains closed.
context: Equipment-case fastening requires seating a separate hook, tensioning it and securing an independent safety catch. A flat lever on an unattached hook is insufficient; the closed loose case must remain secured with both hands away.

Two steel spring hooks/levers percase,three5mm keepers at6mm pitch; A has7mm secondary catches. Two40x160mm,.30kg upright steel instrument surrogates with42x12mm caps at(.35,+.10,.894) and(.35,-.18,.894). Complete95collider inventory, masses, poses and physicalseed42 in README/fixture.json.
